source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.11.1 with Figure 10.3, printed page 225.

blocks.text: Mana jata hai ke absolute (akele electrode ka asal) electrode potential napa nahi ja sakta, kyun ke jab element ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jata hai to electrical double layer ban jati hai. Misal: zinc ko zinc ions wale solution mein rakhein to metal ki surface (satah) ke bohat thore zinc atoms zinc ions ban kar solution mein chale jate hain. Is se zinc ki surface par electrons zyada (excess) reh jate hain.

blocks.alt: Zinc rod ZnSO4 (aq) mein dooba hai. Solution ke andar rod ki dono surfaces par negative charges (electrons) hain, aur har taraf un ke saamne +2 wale gol nishanon ki line hai jis par 'Zinc(II) ions' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Electrical double layer ka banna (kitab ki Figure 10.3 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Zinc rod ki surface par negative charge (electrons, −) ki tah hai aur us ke saamne solution mein Zn²⁺ (+2) ions ki tah. Yahi do layers (tahen) mil kar 'double layer' hain, aur in ke darmiyan voltage banta hai.

Ab metal ke ird-gird solution mein Zn²⁺ ions zyada hain. In mein se kuch cations zinc ki surface ki taraf khinch kar us ke saath lag jate hain. Is tarah electrical double layer banti hai. Charge ke is jama hone se metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan electric potential (voltage) paida hota hai, jaisa Figure 10.3 mein hai.

Double layer ki wajah se yeh potential seedha (directly) napa nahi ja sakta. Lekin metal/metal ion system aur kisi doosre system ke potential ka farq (difference) napa ja sakta hai. Is value ko electrode potential, E, kehte hain aur yeh volts mein napa jata hai. Muqable (comparison) ke liye standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Electrical double layer kaise banti hai aur absolute potential kyun nahi napa ja sakta?
blocks.explanation: Surface ke kuch metal atoms electrons chhor kar ions ban jate hain; electrons metal par aur cations surface ke qareeb solution mein jama ho jate hain: do layers. Is potential ko napne ke liye voltmeter ka doosra end (sira) bhi solution mein dalna parega, jo khud ek naya electrode banata hai; is liye sirf do electrodes ka farq napa ja sakta hai.

items: Zn²⁺ solution mein zinc: kuch atoms ions ban kar nikalte hain, metal par electrons reh jate hain; cations surface par: electrical double layer aur voltage.
Absolute potential nahi napa ja sakta; SHE ke muqable farq = electrode potential E (volts).
